verdict.rationale: Zero's docs list 'Compose emails with AI assistance' alongside creating and sending drafts, and the founder says it 'drafts replies'. So AI-drafted replies that can be reviewed before sending are supported. Nothing in the evidence shows the drafts adapt to the user's own voice, tone, or past writing rather than producing generic text. Missing for 10: evidence of voice/tone personalization (learning from sent mail or style settings), documentation of the reply-drafting UX and review flow, and independent hands-on corroboration of draft quality.
